changes.name: SkyboundEggSystem
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local eggs={
 {map.StarterEgg.HatchPrompt,1000000,{{"Cloud Bunny",55},{"Sky Fox",30},{"Sun Cub",12},{"Storm Dragon",2.8},{"Aurora Griffin",.2}}},
 {map.WaterfallIsles.Egg.HatchPrompt,3000000,{{"Bubble Bunny",55},{"River Fox",30},{"Aqua Cub",12},{"Tide Dragon",2.8},{"Prism Axolotl",.2}}},
 {map.DesertTemple.Egg.HatchPrompt,10000000,{{"Sand Bunny",55},{"Dune Fox",30},{"Sun Lion",12},{"Pharaoh Dragon",2.8},{"Solar Sphinx",.2}}},
 {map.FrozenPeaks.FrozenEgg.Egg.HatchPrompt,30000000,{{"Snow Hare",55},{"Frost Fox",30},{"Ice Bear",12},{"Glacier Dragon",2.8},{"Aurora Yeti",.2}}},
 {map.VolcanoRealm.Egg.HatchPrompt,100000000,{{"Ember Bunny",55},{"Magma Fox",30},{"Lava Golem",12},{"Inferno Dragon",2.8},{"Phoenix",.2}}},
 {map.CelestialCity.Egg.HatchPrompt,300000000,{{"Star Bunny",55},{"Comet Fox",30},{"Moon Guardian",12},{"Galaxy Dragon",2.8},{"Celestial Seraph",.2}}},
 {map.VoidRealm.Egg.HatchPrompt,1000000000,{{"Void Bunny",55},{"Shadow Fox",30},{"Rift Beast",12},{"Void Dragon",2.8},{"Eclipse Leviathan",.2}}}
}
local rarity={55="Common",30="Uncommon",12="Epic",[2.8]="Legendary",[.2]="Secret"}
local function roll(t)
 local r=math.random()*100;local s=0
 for _,x in ipairs(t) do s+=x[2];if r<=s then return x[1],rarity[x[2]] end end
 return t[1][1],"Common"
end
for _,e in ipairs(eggs) do
 local prompt,cost,pets=e[1],e[2],e[3];prompt.ActionText="HATCH";prompt.ObjectText="EGG • "..cost.." SKY COINS"
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
  local coins=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not coins or coins.Value<cost then return end
  coins.Value-=cost
  local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then inv=Instance.new("Folder");inv.Name="Pets";inv.Parent=p end
  local name,r=roll(pets);local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name="Pet";v.Value=name;v:SetAttribute("Rarity",r);v.Parent=inv
  p:SetAttribute("LastHatch",name);p:SetAttribute("LastHatchRarity",r);p:SetAttribute("HatchSerial",(p:GetAttribute("HatchSerial") or 0)+1)
  local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets");if eq and #eq:GetChildren()<3 then local q=Instance.new("StringValue");q.Name="Pet";q.Value=name;q.Parent=eq end
 end)
end

changes.name: SkyboundPortalSystem
changes.source:
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local gates={
 {map.WaterfallPortal,"WaterfallUnlocked",5000000,map.WaterfallIsles},
 {map.WaterfallIsles.DesertPortal,"DesertUnlocked",25000000,map.DesertTemple},
 {map.DesertTemple.FrozenPortal,"FrozenUnlocked",100000000,map.FrozenPeaks},
 {map.FrozenPeaks.VolcanoPortal,"VolcanoRealmUnlocked",400000000,map.VolcanoRealm},
 {map.VolcanoRealm.CelestialPortal,"CelestialCityUnlocked",1500000000,map.CelestialCity},
 {map.CelestialCity.VoidPortal,"VoidRealmUnlocked",5000000000,map.VoidRealm}
}
for _,g in ipairs(gates) do
 local portal,key,cost,dest=g[1],g[2],g[3],g[4];local prompt=portal:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
 if prompt then prompt.ActionText="UNLOCK / TRAVEL";prompt.ObjectText=tostring(cost).." SKY COINS"
  prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
   local c=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not c then return end
   if not p:GetAttribute(key) then if c.Value<cost then return end;c.Value-=cost;p:SetAttribute(key,true) end
   local r=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if r then r.CFrame=CFrame.new(dest.IslandTop.Position+Vector3.new(0,8,0)) end
  end)
 end
end
local returns={{map.WaterfallIsles,"GrasslandsTop"},{map.DesertTemple,"WaterfallIsles"},{map.FrozenPeaks,"DesertTemple"},{map.VolcanoRealm,"FrozenPeaks"},{map.CelestialCity,"VolcanoRealm"},{map.VoidRealm,"CelestialCity"}}
for _,x in ipairs(returns) do
 local area,target=x[1],x[2];local rp=area:FindFirstChild("ReturnPortal");if rp then local pr=rp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt");if pr then pr.ActionText="RETURN";pr.ObjectText="PREVIOUS ISLAND";pr.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
  local r=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not r then return end
  local d=target=="GrasslandsTop" and map.GrasslandsTop or map[target].IslandTop;r.CFrame=CFrame.new(d.Position+Vector3.new(0,8,0))
 end) end end
end

changes.name: SkyboundGoals
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local claim=RS:WaitForChild("SkyboundClaimReward")
local rewards={1000000,3000000,10000000,30000000,100000000,300000000,1000000000}
local function setup(p)
 p:SetAttribute("QuestOrbs",0);p:SetAttribute("QuestGoal",15);p:SetAttribute("QuestReward",5000000);p:SetAttribute("QuestReady",false)
 p:SetAttribute("DailyReady",true)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
claim.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,kind)
 local c=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not c then return end
 if kind=="Quest" and p:GetAttribute("QuestReady") then c.Value+=p:GetAttribute("QuestReward") or 0;p:SetAttribute("QuestOrbs",0);p:SetAttribute("QuestGoal",math.min(100,(p:GetAttribute("QuestGoal") or 15)+10));p:SetAttribute("QuestReward",math.floor((p:GetAttribute("QuestReward") or 5000000)*1.8));p:SetAttribute("QuestReady",false)
 elseif kind=="Daily" and p:GetAttribute("DailyReady") then c.Value+=rewards[1];p:SetAttribute("DailyReady",false) end
end)
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
for _,d in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") and (d.Name:find("Orb") or d.Parent and (d.Parent.Name=="SkyCoins" or d.Parent.Name=="Orbs" or d.Parent.Name:find("Coins"))) then
 d.Touched:Connect(function(hit) local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent);if p then local n=(p:GetAttribute("QuestOrbs") or 0)+1;p:SetAttribute("QuestOrbs",n);if n>=(p:GetAttribute("QuestGoal") or 15) then p:SetAttribute("QuestReady",true) end end end)
end end

changes.name: SkyboundProfessionalUI
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players");local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local pg=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
for _,n in ipairs({"SkyboundHUD","SkyboundStats","SkyboundAreaHUD","PetIndexUI","PetCraftUI","PetInventoryUI"}) do local x=pg:FindFirstChild(n);if x then x:Destroy() end end
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="SkyboundUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.IgnoreGuiInset=false;gui.Parent=pg
local function round(o,r) local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 12);c.Parent=o end
local function stroke(o) local s=Instance.new("UIStroke");s.Thickness=2;s.Transparency=.55;s.Parent=o end
local top=Instance.new("Frame");top.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(270,58);top.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-135,0,14);top.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,55,100);top.BackgroundTransparency=.08;top.Parent=gui;round(top,18);stroke(top)
local coins=Instance.new("TextLabel");coins.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,0);coins.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0);coins.BackgroundTransparency=1;coins.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,235,90);coins.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;coins.TextScaled=true;coins.Parent=top
local power=Instance.new("TextLabel");power.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(190,38);power.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-95,0,78);power.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(110,75,190);power.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);power.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;power.TextScaled=true;power.Parent=gui;round(power,14)
local nav=Instance.new("Frame");nav.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(118,250);nav.Position=UDim2.new(0,16,.5,-125);nav.BackgroundTransparency=1;nav.Parent=gui
local lay=Instance.new("UIListLayout");lay.Padding=UDim.new(0,9);lay.Parent=nav
local panel=Instance.new("Frame");panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(520,430);panel.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-260,.5,-200);panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,42,75);panel.Visible=false;panel.Parent=gui;round(panel,20);stroke(panel)
local title=Instance.new("TextLabel");title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,55);title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,8);title.BackgroundTransparency=1;title.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;title.TextScaled=true;title.Parent=panel
local close=Instance.new("TextButton");close.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(46,46);close.Position=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,10);close.Text="×";close.TextScaled=true;close.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,80,100);close.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);close.Parent=panel;round(close,14)
local body=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame");body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,72);body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,1,-90);body.BackgroundTransparency=1;body.BorderSizePixel=0;body.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;body.CanvasSize=UDim2.new();body.Parent=panel
local bl=Instance.new("UIListLayout");bl.Padding=UDim.new(0,8);bl.Parent=body
local function clear() for _,x in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do if x~=bl then x:Destroy() end end end
local function row(text,click)
 local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,54);b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(62,78,125);b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);b.Text=text;b.TextScaled=true;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.Parent=body;round(b,13);if click then b.Activated:Connect(click) end;return b
end
local function open(kind)
 clear();panel.Visible=true;title.Text=kind
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets")
 if kind=="PETS" then
  if inv then for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do local n=v.Value;row(n.."   •   CLICK TO EQUIP",function() RS.SkyboundEquipPet:FireServer(n) end) end end
 elseif kind=="INDEX" then
  local seen={};if inv then for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do seen[v.Value]=true end end
  local names={"Cloud Bunny","Sky Fox","Sun Cub","Storm Dragon","Aurora Griffin","Bubble Bunny","River Fox","Aqua Cub","Tide Dragon","Prism Axolotl","Sand Bunny","Dune Fox","Sun Lion","Pharaoh Dragon","Solar Sphinx","Snow Hare","Frost Fox","Ice Bear","Glacier Dragon","Aurora Yeti","Ember Bunny","Magma Fox","Lava Golem","Inferno Dragon","Phoenix","Star Bunny","Comet Fox","Moon Guardian","Galaxy Dragon","Celestial Seraph","Void Bunny","Shadow Fox","Rift Beast","Void Dragon","Eclipse Leviathan"}
  for _,n in ipairs(names) do row(seen[n] and "✓  "..n or "🔒  UNDISCOVERED") end
 elseif kind=="CRAFT" then
  local counts={};if inv then for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do counts[v.Value]=(counts[v.Value] or 0)+1 end end
  for n,c in pairs(counts) do row(n.."  ×"..c..(c>=3 and "   → SHINY" or "   • NEED 3"),function() if c>=3 then RS.SkyboundCraftPet:FireServer(n) end end) end
 elseif kind=="REWARDS" then
  local goal=p:GetAttribute("QuestGoal") or 15;local q=p:GetAttribute("QuestOrbs") or 0
  row("QUEST: COLLECT ORBS  "..q.."/"..goal,function() if p:GetAttribute("QuestReady") then RS.SkyboundClaimReward:FireServer("Quest") end end)
  row(p:GetAttribute("DailyReady") and "DAILY GIFT • CLAIM" or "DAILY GIFT • CLAIMED",function() if p:GetAttribute("DailyReady") then RS.SkyboundClaimReward:FireServer("Daily") end end)
 end
end
for _,n in ipairs({"PETS","INDEX","CRAFT","REWARDS"}) do local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(118,52);b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(75,145,235);b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);b.Text=n;b.TextScaled=true;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;b.Parent=nav;round(b,14);stroke(b);b.Activated:Connect(function() open(n) end) end
close.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible=false end)
local hatch=Instance.new("Frame");hatch.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(400,180);hatch.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-200,.5,-90);hatch.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,55,95);hatch.Visible=false;hatch.Parent=gui;round(hatch,24);stroke(hatch)
local ht=Instance.new("TextLabel");ht.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-20);ht.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10);ht.BackgroundTransparency=1;ht.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);ht.TextScaled=true;ht.TextWrapped=true;ht.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;ht.Parent=hatch
local serial=p:GetAttribute("HatchSerial") or 0
p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HatchSerial"):Connect(function() local s=p:GetAttribute("HatchSerial") or 0;if s==serial then return end;serial=s;ht.Text="YOU HATCHED!\n"..tostring(p:GetAttribute("LastHatch")).."\n"..tostring(p:GetAttribute("LastHatchRarity"));hatch.Visible=true;task.delay(2.4,function() hatch.Visible=false end) end)
local function fmt(n) n=tonumber(n) or 0;if n>=1e9 then return string.format("%.2fB",n/1e9) elseif n>=1e6 then return string.format("%.2fM",n/1e6) elseif n>=1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK",n/1e3) end;return tostring(n) end
task.spawn(function() while task.wait(.2) do local c=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");coins.Text="☁  "..fmt(c and c.Value or 0).." SKY COINS";power.Text="⚡ PET POWER  "..tostring(p:GetAttribute("PetPower") or 0) end end)
